tagline: Review for an agent driving a signed-in browser vault: page actions, saved-credential fill and screenshots.
summary: Auth Your Agent gives an AI agent a signed-in browser whose passwords and authenticator codes stay in the owner's vault. This opt-in coverage reviews the tools that act on the page (navigate, click, type_text, press_key, select_option, go_back), fill_secret, request_approval and screenshot. Reads, status checks, take over and sign-out follow normal Guard policy. Separately, the server can ask the owner on their phone before committing clicks, depending on the approval mode and trusted sites the owner has set.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the reviewed Auth Your Agent MCP tools and the surrounding Guard policy.
Matching applies to the authyouragent-mcp package launched through npx; other launchers or registries fall back to normal Guard policy.
Phone approval is enforced by the Auth Your Agent server, not by Guard, and depends on the owner's approval mode: some modes and trusted sites let clicks through without asking.
A publisher profile or badge is not a security certification or an endorsement by HOL.
